info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Validates-v1-spec
info.description: The Tickets Validation API allows organizations to verify the validity of event tickets before entry. This endpoint enables event organizers, ticketing platforms, and customer service representatives to ensure that tickets presented at the venue are legitimate and have not been used or duplicated. By providing essential details about the ticket, this API facilitates a smoother check-in experience and reduces the risk of fraud. Typical use cases include validating tickets for concerts, sports events, and other large gatherings.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to validate a ticket by providing the necessary ticket information. The validation process ensures that the ticket is legitimate and meets all required criteria.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate ticket information prior to processing. Ensure that all required fields are included for a successful validation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the ticket validation status is returned.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesReque.description: A JSON string used as the request body for validation operations in the GET tickets API.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesRespo.title: Ticket Validation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket validation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket validation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the validation process.

state.description: Current state of the ticket validation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the ticket validation, in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message related to the ticket validation process.

audit.description: Audit information for the ticket validation process.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesRespo.description: Response schema for the ticket validation GET operation, indicating the status and details of the ticket validation process.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the validation request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the ticket validation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the ticket validation process was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Detailed record of the audit information for the ticket validation process.
